Play a game against the Snowhill Snowspurs with them.' (3355830634). Client locale 37945 'Snowhill Soccer' is the name_id of MiniGameData row 43 in data/content/soccer.json.

T403 goal text Global.Text 441183 'Win a Snowhill Soccer minigame': exact locale match for the guide goal 2216136620 (lab/reports/locale-id-map.json hash_to_ids['2216136620'] = [441183]), sent as the 49/3 goal name and description.

(R) T409: objective id 1 and count 1 are local; the guide names one Snowhill Soccer win. Only a server-settled win of game 43 emits FinishMinigame { 43 } (Gameplay::tick_world -> npc_minigame_win, T259); a loss, a quit or another field does not.

(R) T409: the guide records no Snowy Scrimmage reward ('Rewards are largely unknown'; no quest-complete frame). 10 coins and 25 Soccer Star (profile 52) XP are the T244 job-entry rung on the T202 small bonus ladder (25 for a single follow-up objective); no item is granted.
